Implementation: when pred(item) true: if keep_separator: yield buf + [item] maybe? But the spec: "determines whether the separator is included in the resulting chunks." Means if keep_separator True, the separator item goes into the next chunk? In split_at example treating delimiting items not included. If keep_separator True, maybe include in subsequent chunk. We'll implement: if pred(item) then yield buf, and if keep_separator: start new buf with [item] else buf empty. However typical split_at: splits around delimiter, discarding it. If keep_separator True, include it as first item of next chunk. That seems reasonable.
